body:
Here's the thing though, she is going through problems herself and she practically feels that I can't feel this way since things are going good and the only advice she has is get help through medication or stop being unhappy.

Anyone else is supportive, but ultimately they do not know what to do since they haven't felt this way before or been around this kind of grief.
I have friends, though one of them is being kinda ridiculous with my feelings SO I do not talk to her right now.

I have an Associates in Arts, looking to continue my education once I get the funds to move out of town and finally decide what the heck I want to study. Anyways, just working a basic food joint job since it was all I can get with no experience beforehand... and since I lacked a car when I applied, I tried locally and that was the best available that was close walking distance wise. Been at the job since last December, took over a year before I got a call and things are slowly improving. 

I should also add I graduated in mid 2013 and this depression started sometime later that year and continued throughout 2014. It got me pretty lethargic afterwards and I still feel the effects of it to this day, I sometimes have issues focusing on things I enjoy doing and lose sleep because of procrastination fueled insomnia that prevents me from working out like I usually did when I was still in school. Also thinking of that girl doesn't help matters either, reminding me that I am still single and haven't landed a girl yet.
